description: Governor's Secretariat of Central Province - Appointments, Mr. G. K. G. A. R. P. K. Nandana and two others to the Central Provincial Services
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists personnel appointments (named individuals with their titles and start dates) without describing their detailed portfolio responsibilities or making structural changes to government organizations. The content focuses solely on "who" is being appointed to which positions, fitting the criteria for a People Gazette (Type 2).
